passages.title: 夜市的手機殼攤
passages.text: Every Friday night, I help my uncle at the Shilin Night Market. He {1} phone cases there. His stand is small, but it is very popular. A {2} of tourists stop to look at the cute cases. Last week, a little boy came to the stand with his mom. He wanted a case with a cat on it, but he only had a {3} coins. My uncle smiled and gave him a {4}: "If you can say 'thank you' in three languages, I will give you twenty dollars off." The boy thought hard. "Thank you, xie xie, arigato!" he shouted. Everyone around us clapped. My uncle {5} his promise, and the boy left with a big smile. That night, I learned that business is not only about money. Sometimes a kind act brings more customers than a low price.

blanks.why: sell + 物「賣某物」：舅舅在那裡賣手機殼。stays（停留）、becomes（變成）、decides（決定）後面都不能直接接 phone cases。
a lot of + 名詞「很多…」：很多觀光客停下來看。a few 後面直接接名詞，不能加 of；a chance of、a park of 意思不通。
a few + 可數名詞「幾個」：他只有幾個硬幣。a lot 後面要加 of 才能接名詞；care、park 不能這樣用。
give + 人 + a chance「給某人一個機會」：舅舅給他一個挑戰的機會。example 前面要用 an；a park、a stay 意思不通。
keep one's promise「遵守承諾」。lost、sold、cared 接 his promise 都不通。

passages.zh: 每個星期五晚上，我都會去士林夜市幫舅舅的忙。他在那裡賣手機殼。他的攤位很小，但很受歡迎，很多觀光客會停下來看那些可愛的手機殼。上星期，一個小男孩跟媽媽來到攤位前。他想要一個有貓咪圖案的手機殼，但他只有幾個硬幣。舅舅笑著給了他一個機會：「如果你能用三種語言說『謝謝』，我就算你便宜二十元。」男孩努力想了想，大喊：「Thank you、謝謝、ありがとう！」周圍的人都拍起手來。舅舅遵守了承諾，男孩帶著大大的笑容離開了。那天晚上我學到，做生意不只是為了錢。有時候，一個善意的舉動比低價更能吸引客人。

passages.title: 停車場裡的小貓
passages.text: Mr. Chen {1} his car in front of the supermarket and went in to buy some milk. When he came back, he heard a small sound under the car. It was a kitten! It looked weak and scared. "Did my car {2} you?" he asked. He looked at it carefully. Luckily, it was fine; it was only hungry. Mr. Chen gave it some of his milk, and the kitten drank it quickly. He could not just {3} it there, so he took it home. His daughter was very happy. "Can we keep it?" she asked. "Only if you promise to take {4} of it every day," he said. She agreed right away. Now the kitten has a name, Lucky, and a {5} of toys. Every morning, it waits for Mr. Chen next to his car.

blanks.why: park + 車「停車」：陳先生把車停在超市前面。cared、stayed、decided 都不能接 his car。
hurt + 人／動物「弄傷」：我的車有弄傷你嗎？sell you（賣你）、stay you、care you 都不通。
leave + 物 + 地方「把…留在某處」：他不能就把小貓留在那裡。stay、become、decide 都不能接 it there。
take care of「照顧」是固定片語。take chance of、take example of、take lot of 都不是正確用法。
a lot of toys「很多玩具」。a few 後面不加 of；a chance of toys、a park of toys 意思不通。

passages.zh: 陳先生把車停在超市前面，進去買牛奶。他回來的時候，聽到車子底下有個小小的聲音。是一隻小貓！牠看起來又虛弱又害怕。「我的車有弄傷你嗎？」他問。他仔細看了看，幸好牠沒事，只是肚子餓了。陳先生把一些牛奶分給牠，小貓很快就喝光了。他不能就這樣把牠留在那裡，於是把牠帶回家。他的女兒非常開心。「我們可以養牠嗎？」她問。「只要你答應每天照顧牠就可以。」他說。她馬上就答應了。現在小貓有了名字叫 Lucky，還有很多玩具。每天早上，牠都會在陳先生的車子旁邊等他。

passages.title: 輸掉決賽之後
passages.text: Our class basketball team {1} the final game by one point. Everyone was sad, and Tom cried in the locker room. He missed the last shot and fell down. "It is all my fault," he said. Our coach sat down next to him. "Did you {2} your leg when you fell?" she asked first. Tom shook his head. "Then that is the most important thing," she said. "Games are just games. For {3}, last year we lost five games in a row, but we did not give up. This year, we got to the final. Next year, you will have another {4} to win." Tom wiped his tears and smiled a little. The next day, he came to practice early and {5} late. He wanted to be ready for next year.

blanks.why: lose a game「輸掉比賽」，過去式 lost：以一分之差輸掉決賽。sold、parked、cared 接 the final game 都不通。
hurt one's leg「弄傷腳」：你跌倒時有傷到腳嗎？sell、stay、park 接 your leg 都不通。
for example「例如」是固定片語。for chance、for lot、for care 都不是片語。
have another chance to + 原形動詞「有另一次機會做…」：明年你還有機會贏。another example to win、another park、another lot 都不通。
stay late「待到很晚」：他提早來練習，也留到很晚。sold late、lost late、hurt late 都不通。

passages.zh: 我們班的籃球隊以一分之差輸掉了決賽。大家都很難過，Tom 在更衣室裡哭了。他投丟了最後一球，還跌倒了。「全都是我的錯。」他說。教練在他旁邊坐下，第一句話就問：「你跌倒的時候有傷到腳嗎？」Tom 搖搖頭。「那就是最重要的事，」她說，「比賽就只是比賽。例如去年我們連輸五場，但我們沒有放棄。今年我們打進了決賽。明年，你還會有另一次贏球的機會。」Tom 擦乾眼淚，微微笑了。隔天，他很早就來練球，還留到很晚。他想為明年做好準備。

passages.title: 二手書義賣
passages.text: Our school library had a used book sale last Saturday. Students brought old books from home, and we {1} them for ten dollars each. The money was for children in the mountains. Many of them have only a {2} books at home. I was worried that nobody would come. However, many people came, and the sale was very {3}. An old man bought twenty books. "I {4} all my books in a fire last year," he said. "Now I want to start again." At the end of the day, we had more than eight thousand dollars. Our librarian said, "This is a great {5} of how small acts can help others." I felt proud. Next year, I will bring even more books.

blanks.why: sell + 物 + for + 價錢「以…價錢賣」：我們一本賣十元。lost、hurt、stayed 都不能接「for 價錢」。
a few + 可數名詞「幾本」：他們家裡只有幾本書。a lot 後面要加 of；a chance books、a care books 都不通。
be very popular「很受歡迎」。very likely 後面要接 to 或句子；very enough、very last 都不是正確說法。
lose + 物 + in a fire「在火災中失去」，過去式 lost。sold、parked、cared 和「在火災中」搭配都不通。
an example of …「…的例子」：這是小小舉動能幫助別人的好例子。a great chance of how、a great lot of how、a great park of how 都不通。

passages.zh: 上星期六，我們學校圖書館舉辦了二手書義賣。學生從家裡帶來舊書，我們一本賣十元。這些錢要送給山上的孩子，他們很多人家裡只有幾本書。我本來擔心沒人會來，然而來了很多人，義賣非常受歡迎。一位老先生買了二十本書。「我去年在一場火災中失去了所有的書，」他說，「現在我想重新開始。」一天結束時，我們募到了八千多元。圖書館員說：「這是小小舉動也能幫助別人的好例子。」我覺得很驕傲。明年我要帶更多書來。

passages.title: 雨天的客廳城堡
passages.text: It rained all weekend, so my family had to {1} at home. My little brother was bored. "There is nothing to do!" he cried. Mom had an idea. "Let's build a fort in the living room," she said. We used chairs, blankets, and a {2} of pillows. Then we brought flashlights inside the fort and read stories. Dad made popcorn, but he dropped the bowl, and a {3} pieces fell on the floor. Our dog ate them in one second! Everyone laughed. I {4} that day more than a sunny day at the beach. Sometimes bad weather gives us a {5} to spend time together.

blanks.why: stay at home「待在家裡」。become、mean、hurt 都不能和 at home 搭配表示「待在家」。
a lot of pillows「很多枕頭」。a few 後面不加 of；a chance of、an example of 意思不通。
a few pieces「幾塊、幾片」。a lot 後面要加 of；a chance pieces、a care pieces 都不通。
enjoy + 事物「享受、喜歡」：我喜歡那一天勝過晴天去海邊。sold、lost、hurt 接 that day 都不通。
give + 人 + a chance to + 原形動詞「給某人做…的機會」。example 前要用 an；a care、a hurt 都不通。

passages.zh: 整個週末都在下雨，所以我們全家只好待在家裡。弟弟很無聊，大叫：「沒事可做！」媽媽想到一個點子：「我們在客廳蓋一座堡壘吧。」我們用了椅子、毯子和很多枕頭。接著我們把手電筒拿進堡壘裡講故事。爸爸做了爆米花，卻把碗打翻了，幾顆爆米花掉到地上，我們家的狗一秒就吃光了！大家都笑了。比起晴天去海邊，我更喜歡那一天。有時候，壞天氣反而給了我們一起相處的機會。

passages.title: 公園長椅上的爺爺
passages.text: Every morning, an old man sits on the same bench in the {1} near my school. He feeds the birds and says hello to every student. One day, he was not there. The next day, and the day after, the bench was still empty. I was worried. Did he get sick? Did he {2} himself? A week later, he came back with a bandage on his arm. "I fell down at home," he said. "My son told me to {3} in bed, but I missed the birds too much." I told him to take {4} of himself. He laughed and gave me a {5} pieces of bread. "Here, you can feed them too," he said. Now I stop at the bench every morning, and the birds know my face.

blanks.why: in the park「在公園裡」：學校附近公園裡的長椅。in the chance、in the example、in the care 都不通。
hurt oneself「弄傷自己、受傷」。stay、decide、mean 接 himself 都不通。
tell + 人 + to stay in bed「叫某人躺在床上休息」。sell、lose、hurt 接 in bed 都不通。
take care of oneself「照顧好自己」。take chance of、take lot of、take example of 都不是正確用法。
a few pieces of bread「幾片麵包」。a lot 後要接 of；a chance pieces、a park pieces 都不通。

passages.zh: 每天早上，都有一位老爺爺坐在學校附近公園裡的同一張長椅上。他會餵鳥，也會跟每個學生打招呼。有一天他沒有出現。隔天、再隔天，長椅還是空的。我很擔心：他生病了嗎？他受傷了嗎？一個星期後，他回來了，手臂上纏著繃帶。「我在家裡跌倒了，」他說，「我兒子叫我躺在床上休息，但我太想念這些鳥了。」我叫他要好好照顧自己。他笑了，給了我幾片麵包：「拿去，你也可以餵牠們。」現在我每天早上都會在長椅旁停下來，鳥兒也認得我的臉了。

passages.title: 弄丟的悠遊卡
passages.text: On Monday morning, I could not find my EasyCard. Did I {1} it on the bus? I looked in my bag a {2} times, but it was not there. I had to walk to school, and I was late. My teacher said, "Don't worry. A {3} of students lose their cards every year." After school, I went to the bus company's lost-and-found office. The man there showed me a big box. There were many cards in it, and mine was one of them! "You are lucky," he said. "Next time, put your name on it. Then people will have a better {4} of returning it to you." I said thank you and went home happily. Now my card always {5} in a small pocket inside my bag.

blanks.why: lose + 物「弄丟」：我是在公車上弄丟的嗎？stay、hurt、care 接 it on the bus 都不通。
a few times「幾次」。a lot 後面不能直接接 times（要說 a lot of times）；a chance times、a park times 都不通。
a lot of students「很多學生」。a chance of、a park of、a care of students 都不通。
have a chance of + V-ing「有…的機會」：別人比較有機會把卡還給你。a better example / park / care of returning 都不通。
stay in + 地方「待在、放在某處」：現在我的卡一直放在包包裡的小口袋。sells、hurts、loses 接 in a small pocket 都不通。

passages.zh: 星期一早上，我找不到我的悠遊卡。我是在公車上弄丟的嗎？我翻了書包好幾次，還是找不到。我只好走路上學，結果遲到了。老師說：「別擔心，每年都有很多學生弄丟卡片。」放學後，我去了公車公司的失物招領處。那裡的先生拿出一個大箱子，裡面有好多張卡，我的就是其中一張！「你很幸運，」他說，「下次在卡上寫名字，別人就比較有機會把它還給你。」我說了謝謝，開心地回家。現在我的卡都放在書包裡的一個小口袋。

passages.title: 阿福的腳受傷了
passages.text: My shiba inu, Afu, loves running on the beach. Last summer, he stepped on a piece of glass and {1} his foot. He could not walk well, so we took him to the animal doctor. The doctor said, "He needs to {2} at home and rest for two weeks." Afu did not like it at all. He {3} interest in his toys and just looked out of the window all day. My sister had an idea. "Let's take him to the {4} in a baby stroller!" People in the park laughed when they saw a dog in a stroller, but Afu was very happy. He could feel the wind again. Two weeks later, his foot was better. Now we {5} him away from the dirty part of the beach.

blanks.why: hurt one's foot「弄傷腳」，hurt 的過去式還是 hurt。sold、stayed、parked 接 his foot 都不通。
stay at home「待在家」：牠需要在家休息兩週。sell、become、care 接 at home 都不通。
lose interest in …「對…失去興趣」，過去式 lost。sold、parked、cared interest 都不通。
take + 人／動物 + to the park「帶…去公園」，下一句也提到 the park。chance、example、care 都不是地方。
keep + 人／動物 + away from …「讓…遠離…」。sell、lose、hurt 和 away from 搭配都不通。

passages.zh: 我的柴犬阿福很喜歡在海灘上奔跑。去年夏天，牠踩到一塊玻璃，弄傷了腳。牠走路一拐一拐的，所以我們帶牠去看獸醫。醫生說：「牠需要待在家休息兩個星期。」阿福一點都不喜歡。牠對玩具失去了興趣，整天只是望著窗外。姊姊想到一個點子：「我們用嬰兒車推牠去公園吧！」公園裡的人看到嬰兒車裡坐著一隻狗都笑了，但阿福非常開心，牠又能吹到風了。兩個星期後，牠的腳好了。現在我們都讓牠遠離海灘上髒亂的地方。

passages.title: 幫阿嬤顧水果攤
passages.text: Grandma {1} fruit at the morning market. Last Sunday, she had a bad cold, so she asked me to take {2} of her stand. I was nervous because I had never {3} fruit to strangers before. At first, only a {4} people stopped, and they did not buy anything. Then I remembered Grandma's words: "Smile and say hello to everyone." I started to talk with every customer and let them taste the mangoes. Soon, more and more people came. Some even said they would come back next week. It was a good {5} for me to practice talking with people. When I got home, all the mangoes were gone. Grandma was so proud that she gave me the biggest one in the house.

blanks.why: sell + 物「賣」：阿嬤在早市賣水果。stays、cares、hurts 都不能直接接 fruit 表示「賣」。
take care of「照顧、負責」：請我顧她的攤位。take chance of、take lot of、take example of 都不對。
sell + 物 + to + 人「把…賣給某人」，現在完成式用 sold：我從來沒有把水果賣給陌生人過。stayed、cared、felt 都不能接「物 to 人」。
a few people「幾個人」。a lot 後面要加 of；a chance people、a park people 都不通。
a good chance for me to + 原形動詞「對我來說是個好機會」。a good park、a good care、a good hurt 都不通。

passages.zh: 阿嬤在早市賣水果。上星期天她得了重感冒，所以請我幫她顧攤位。我很緊張，因為我從來沒有把水果賣給陌生人過。一開始，只有幾個人停下來，而且都沒買。接著我想起阿嬤的話：「要微笑，跟每個人打招呼。」我開始和每位客人聊天，也請他們試吃芒果。很快地，來的人愈來愈多，有些人甚至說下星期還會再來。這對我來說是練習和人說話的好機會。我回到家時，芒果全都賣完了。阿嬤好驕傲，把家裡最大顆的芒果給了我。

passages.title: 小小兵的香蕉生意
passages.text: The Minions wanted to make money, so they decided to {1} bananas in the park. Kevin made a big sign, and Bob brought a {2} of bananas from home. The first day went well. Many children came, and the Minions sold almost every banana. But there was one problem: the Minions loved bananas too much. Every time they sold one, they ate two! At the end of the day, they had {3} money instead of making it. Gru laughed. "This is a good {4} of why you should not eat your own products." So the next day, Kevin put all the bananas in a box, and only Stuart had the key. Stuart {5} next to the box all day to watch it. This time, the Minions finally made some money.

blanks.why: sell bananas「賣香蕉」：小小兵決定在公園賣香蕉。stay、care、hurt 都不能接 bananas 表示做生意。
a lot of bananas「很多香蕉」。a few 後面不加 of；a chance of、an example of bananas 意思不通。
lose money「賠錢」，與後面的 make money（賺錢）相對。hurt、cared、stayed 接 money 都不通。
an example of why …「說明為什麼…的例子」。a good chance of why、a good park、a good lot of why 都不通。
stay next to …「待在…旁邊」：Stuart 整天守在箱子旁邊。sold、lost、hurt next to the box 都不通。

passages.zh: 小小兵想賺錢，所以決定在公園裡賣香蕉。Kevin 做了一個大招牌，Bob 從家裡帶來很多香蕉。第一天很順利，很多小朋友來買，小小兵幾乎把每根香蕉都賣掉了。但有一個問題：小小兵太愛香蕉了。每賣出一根，他們就吃掉兩根！一天結束時，他們不但沒賺到錢，反而還賠錢。格魯笑著說：「這就是為什麼不該吃自己商品的好例子。」於是隔天，Kevin 把香蕉全放進一個箱子，只有 Stuart 有鑰匙。Stuart 整天守在箱子旁邊看著它。這一次，小小兵終於賺到了一點錢。

passages.title: 阿里山看日出
passages.text: Last winter, my family went to Alishan to see the sunrise. We had to get up at three in the morning, and it was very cold. Dad {1} the car at the station, and we took the small train up the mountain. A {2} of people were already waiting at the top. We found a place and waited. My little sister was so sleepy that she almost fell off the bench. "Be careful! Don't {3} yourself," Mom said. At six o'clock, the sky turned orange, and the sun slowly came up over the sea of clouds. It was so beautiful that nobody said a word. I took a {4} pictures, but they could not show how beautiful it really was. Next time, I want to {5} there for two nights.

blanks.why: park the car「停車」：爸爸把車停在車站。stayed、cared、became 都不能接 the car。
a lot of people「很多人」。a few 後面不加 of；a chance of、an example of people 都不通。
hurt oneself「弄傷自己」：小心，別受傷了。stay、become、decide 接 yourself 都不通。
a few pictures「幾張照片」。a lot 後面要加 of；a chance pictures、a care pictures 都不通。
stay there for two nights「在那裡住兩晚」。sell、lose、hurt 接 there for two nights 都不通。

passages.zh: 去年冬天，我們全家去阿里山看日出。我們凌晨三點就得起床，天氣非常冷。爸爸把車停在車站，我們搭小火車上山。山頂上已經有很多人在等了。我們找了個位置等待。妹妹睏到差點從長椅上摔下來。「小心！別受傷了。」媽媽說。六點的時候，天空變成橘色，太陽慢慢從雲海上升起。實在太美了，沒有人說一句話。我拍了幾張照片，但照片拍不出它真正的美。下次，我想在那裡住兩個晚上。

passages.title: 被盜的遊戲帳號
passages.text: Jack loves playing online games. He spent two years building a strong character. One day, he got a message: "You won a free prize! Just give us your password." Jack was excited, so he did it. The next morning, he could not log in. He had {1} his account! Someone took all his items and {2} them to other players. Jack was very upset. His older brother said, "This happens to a {3} of players. Many free prizes are not really free." Jack {4} to start a new account. This time, he takes good {5} of his password and never gives it to anyone.

blanks.why: lose one's account「失去帳號」，過去完成式 had lost。cared、stayed、parked 接 his account 都不通。
sell + 物 + to + 人「把…賣給某人」：有人把他的道具賣給其他玩家。stayed、cared、hurt 都不能接「物 to 人」。
a lot of players「很多玩家」。a few 後面不加 of；a chance of、a park of players 都不通。
decide to + 原形動詞「決定做…」：Jack 決定重新開一個帳號。stayed to start、sold to start、hurt to start 都不通。
take good care of「好好保管、照顧」。take good chance / example / lot of 都不是正確用法。

passages.zh: Jack 很喜歡玩線上遊戲，他花了兩年練出一個很強的角色。有一天，他收到一則訊息：「你贏得免費獎品！只要把密碼給我們就好。」Jack 很興奮，就照做了。隔天早上，他登入不了，他的帳號不見了！有人拿走他所有的道具，還把它們賣給其他玩家。Jack 非常難過。哥哥說：「很多玩家都遇過這種事。很多免費的獎品其實一點也不免費。」Jack 決定重新開一個帳號。這一次，他好好保管自己的密碼，從來不給任何人。

passages.title: 樂高停車場
passages.text: My little brother Leo loves Lego. Last month, he built a big Lego city in his room. It had houses, a school, and even a {1} with trees and a small lake. But his favorite part was the parking lot. He {2} all his toy cars there in neat lines. One day, our cat jumped on the table and knocked down half of the city. Leo cried. A {3} cars were broken, and some pieces were {4} under the bed. I wanted to help, so I {5} up late with him, and we built the city again. This time, we put a high wall around it. "Now the cat cannot get in," Leo said with a smile.

blanks.why: a park with trees「有樹的公園」。a chance、an example、a care with trees 都不通。
park + 車 + 地方「把車停在…」：他把玩具車整齊地停在那裡。stayed、cared、became 都不能接 his toy cars。
a few cars「幾台車」。a lot 後面要加 of；a chance cars、a park cars 都不通。
be lost「不見了、遺失」：有些零件掉到床底下找不到。were sold under the bed 不合理，were cared、were stayed 文法錯誤。
stay up late「熬夜」：我陪他熬夜重新蓋。sold up、hurt up、cared up 都不是片語。

passages.zh: 我弟弟 Leo 很愛樂高。上個月，他在房間裡蓋了一座很大的樂高城市，有房子、學校，甚至還有一座有樹和小湖的公園。但他最喜歡的是停車場，他把所有的玩具車整整齊齊地停在那裡。有一天，我們家的貓跳上桌子，撞倒了半座城市。Leo 哭了。有幾台車壞了，有些零件掉到床底下不見了。我想幫忙，所以陪他熬夜，一起把城市重新蓋好。這一次，我們在城市四周蓋了一道高牆。「這樣貓就進不來了。」Leo 笑著說。

passages.title: 鄉下的暑假
passages.text: This summer, I {1} at my grandparents' house in Yilan for a month. At first, I was not happy. There was no Wi-Fi, and I could not play games. But Grandpa said, "This is a {2} to try new things." Every morning, we fed the chickens and the ducks. Grandma showed me how to {3} for her vegetables. One day, I fell off a bike and {4} my knee. Grandma put some medicine on it and made me a big bowl of noodles. In the evening, we sat outside and looked at the sky. There were a {5} of stars, many more than in Taipei! When it was time to leave, I did not want to go home.

blanks.why: stay at + 地方「住在、待在…」：我在宜蘭的爺爺奶奶家住了一個月。sold、lost、parked 都不能接 at … house。
a chance to + 原形動詞「做…的機會」。example 前面要用 an；a care、a hurt to try 都不通。
care for「照顧」：奶奶教我怎麼照顧她的菜。stay for、sell for、lose for her vegetables 都不通。
hurt one's knee「傷到膝蓋」。sold、stayed、cared 接 my knee 都不通。
a lot of stars「很多星星」。a chance of、a park of、an example of stars 都不通。

passages.zh: 這個暑假，我在宜蘭的爺爺奶奶家住了一個月。一開始我很不開心，那裡沒有 Wi-Fi，也不能玩遊戲。但爺爺說：「這是嘗試新事物的機會。」每天早上，我們都去餵雞和鴨。奶奶教我怎麼照顧她種的菜。有一天，我騎腳踏車摔倒，傷到了膝蓋。奶奶幫我擦藥，還煮了一大碗麵給我吃。晚上，我們坐在外面看天空，有好多星星，比台北多太多了！要離開的時候，我一點都不想回家。

passages.title: 會說故事的英文老師
passages.text: Mr. Wang is my English teacher. He always uses funny stories as {1}. When we learned the past tense, he told us about the day he {2} his shoes at the beach. "I walked home with no shoes, and my feet {3} so much!" We all laughed, and nobody forgot the word "lost." Mr. Wang says that students only remember a {4} words from a textbook, but they remember stories for a long time. So now, when I study new words, I try to make my own stories. It is a fun way to learn, and I do not {5} if my stories are silly.

blanks.why: use … as examples「把…當作例子」。as chances、as parks、as lots 都不通。
lose one's shoes「弄丟鞋子」，過去式 lost；後面他也說要記住 lost 這個字。parked、cared、stayed 接 his shoes 都不通。
my feet hurt「我的腳很痛」，hurt 可以當不及物動詞「疼痛」。sold、stayed、parked so much 都不通。
a few words「幾個字」。a lot 後面要加 of；a chance words、a care words 都不通。
not care if …「不在乎是否…」。sell if、stay if、lose if 都不通。

passages.zh: 王老師是我的英文老師，他總是用好笑的故事當例子。我們學過去式的時候，他講了他在海邊弄丟鞋子的那一天。「我光著腳走回家，腳痛得要命！」我們都笑了，沒有人忘記 lost 這個字。王老師說，學生從課本上只記得住幾個字，但故事卻能記很久。所以現在我背新單字時，都會試著自己編故事。這是很好玩的學習方法，就算故事很傻，我也不在乎。

passages.title: 暑假的愛玉小攤
passages.text: Amy and her cousin wanted to earn some money in the summer, so they decided to {1} lemon aiyu jelly in front of their house. On the first day, it was very hot, and a {2} of people bought a cup. On the second day, it rained, and only a {3} people walked by. The girls felt sad, but Amy's dad said, "Business is like the weather. There are good days and bad days. Don't {4} hope." So they kept going. At the end of the month, they counted their money. They had two thousand dollars! They {5} some of it to buy a gift for Grandma and saved the rest.

blanks.why: sell + 物「賣」：她們決定在家門口賣檸檬愛玉。stay、hurt、care 都不能接 lemon aiyu jelly。
a lot of people「很多人」。a few 後面不加 of；a chance of、an example of people 都不通。
a few people「幾個人」：下雨天只有幾個人經過。a lot 後面要加 of；a chance people、a care people 都不通。
lose hope「失去希望、灰心」。sell hope、park hope、stay hope 都不通。
use + 物 + to + 原形動詞「用…來做…」：她們用一部分的錢買禮物給奶奶。stayed、lost、hurt some of it to buy 都不通。

passages.zh: Amy 和她的表妹想在暑假賺點錢，所以決定在家門口賣檸檬愛玉。第一天天氣很熱，很多人都買了一杯。第二天下雨，只有幾個人經過。兩個女孩很沮喪，但 Amy 的爸爸說：「做生意就像天氣，有好日子也有壞日子，別灰心。」於是她們繼續努力。到了月底，她們把錢數一數，竟然有兩千元！她們用一部分的錢買了禮物送給奶奶，剩下的存了起來。

passages.title: 比賽前扭傷腳
passages.text: Ella practiced every day for the school dance contest. But one week before the contest, she fell during practice and {1} her ankle. The doctor said she needed to {2} in bed for three days. Ella cried. "I will {3} my chance to dance on the stage!" Her teammates came to see her. "Don't worry," said Lucy. "You can still help us. You know the dance better than anyone." So Ella sat next to the stage and watched every practice. She gave the team a {4} of good ideas. On the day of the contest, Ella did not dance, but her team won second place. They gave her the medal. "We could not do it without you," they said. Ella learned that you can {5} about your team even when you cannot play.

blanks.why: hurt one's ankle「傷到腳踝」，hurt 過去式不變。sold、parked、cared 接 her ankle 都不通。
stay in bed「躺在床上休息」。sell、park、lose in bed 都不通。
lose one's chance「失去機會」：我會失去上台跳舞的機會！sell、park、care my chance 都不通。
a lot of good ideas「很多好點子」。a few 後面不加 of；a chance of、a park of ideas 都不通。
care about …「關心、在乎…」：即使不能上場，也能關心團隊。stay about、sell about、lose about 都不通。

passages.zh: Ella 每天都為了學校的舞蹈比賽練習。但比賽前一週，她在練習時跌倒，傷到了腳踝。醫生說她要躺在床上休息三天。Ella 哭著說：「我會失去上台跳舞的機會！」隊友們來看她。「別擔心，」Lucy 說，「你還是可以幫我們。你比任何人都熟悉這支舞。」於是 Ella 坐在舞台旁邊看每一次練習，給了隊伍很多好點子。比賽當天，Ella 沒有上場，但她的隊伍得了第二名，大家把獎牌送給了她。「沒有你，我們做不到。」她們說。Ella 學到，就算不能上場，也能用心關心自己的團隊。

passages.title: 遊樂園的雨天
passages.text: Last Saturday, my friends and I went to an amusement {1}. It was so crowded that we waited in line for two hours for the roller coaster. We only went on a {2} rides in the morning. Then my friend Ben {3} his phone. We looked everywhere for it. Finally, a worker found it under a seat. In the afternoon, it started to rain, so most people went home. But we had umbrellas! That gave us a {4} to ride the roller coaster five times in a row. We {5} until the park closed. It was the best rainy day ever.

blanks.why: amusement park「遊樂園」是固定說法。amusement chance、amusement example、amusement care 都不是正確說法。
a few rides「幾項遊樂設施」。a lot 後面要加 of；a chance rides、a care rides 都不通。
lose one's phone「弄丟手機」，所以後面大家到處找。parked、cared、stayed 接 his phone 都不通。
give + 人 + a chance to + 原形動詞「給某人做…的機會」。example 前面要用 an；a park、a care to ride 都不通。
stay until …「一直待到…」：我們待到樂園關門。sold、lost、hurt until 都不通。

passages.zh: 上星期六，我和朋友去遊樂園。人超多，我們為了坐雲霄飛車排了兩個小時。整個早上我們只玩了幾項設施。接著，我的朋友 Ben 弄丟了手機，我們到處找，最後一位工作人員在座位底下找到了。下午開始下雨，大部分的人都回家了，但我們有帶傘！這讓我們有機會連續坐了五次雲霄飛車。我們一直待到樂園關門。這是最棒的一個雨天。

passages.title: 胖虎的演唱會
passages.text: Gian loves to sing, but his voice {1} everyone's ears. One day, he decided to hold a concert in the {2} and told everyone to come. Nobita and his friends were scared, but they could not say no. "If we don't go, he will be angry," said Suneo. That afternoon, a {3} children sat in front of the stage with cotton in their ears. Gian sang for an hour. After the show, Doraemon gave him a gift: a microphone that makes any voice sound beautiful. Gian was so happy that he {4} on the stage and sang ten more songs. This time, everyone enjoyed the music. But the next day, the microphone was broken, and Gian wanted to hold another concert. The poor children had no {5} to run away.

blanks.why: hurt one's ears「讓耳朵痛」：他的歌聲讓大家耳朵痛。sells、stays、parks 接 everyone's ears 都不通。
in the park「在公園」：在公園舉辦演唱會。in the chance、in the example、in the care 都不通。
a few children「幾個小孩」。a lot 後面要加 of；a chance children、a care children 都不通。
stay on the stage「留在舞台上」：他留在台上又唱了十首歌。sold、lost、hurt on the stage 都不通。
have no chance to + 原形動詞「沒有機會做…」：可憐的孩子們沒機會逃跑。no example / park / care to run away 都不通。

passages.zh: 胖虎很愛唱歌，但他的歌聲會讓大家耳朵痛。有一天，他決定在公園開演唱會，還叫大家都要來。大雄和朋友們很害怕，但又不敢說不。「如果我們不去，他會生氣的。」小夫說。那天下午，幾個孩子耳朵塞著棉花，坐在舞台前面。胖虎唱了一個小時。表演結束後，哆啦A夢送給他一個禮物：一支能讓任何聲音都變好聽的麥克風。胖虎高興得留在台上，又唱了十首歌。這一次，大家都很享受這場音樂會。但隔天，麥克風壞了，胖虎又想再開一場演唱會。可憐的孩子們根本沒有機會逃跑。

passages.title: 牧場少了一隻羊
passages.text: Farmer Lin has fifty sheep on his farm. Every evening, he counts them. One evening, there were only forty-nine. He had {1} one! It was getting dark, but he did not want to wait until morning because he {2} about every one of his sheep. His dog, Max, ran into the woods. A {3} minutes later, Max came back with the little sheep. It could not walk well. It had {4} its leg on a rock. Farmer Lin carried it home and let it {5} in the house that night. The next morning, the little sheep was much better, and Max got an extra bone for breakfast.

blanks.why: lose + 動物「走失、弄丟」，過去完成式 had lost：他少了一隻羊！stayed、cared、parked 接 one 都不通。
care about …「關心、在乎」：他在乎每一隻羊。sold about、stayed about、lost about 都不通。
a few minutes later「幾分鐘後」。a lot 後面要加 of；a chance minutes、a park minutes 都不通。
hurt its leg「傷到腳」。sold、stayed、parked 接 its leg 都不通。
let + 動物 + stay in the house「讓…待在屋裡」。sell、lose、care in the house 都不通。

passages.zh: 林農夫的牧場上有五十隻羊，他每天傍晚都會數一數。有一天傍晚，竟然只有四十九隻，他少了一隻羊！天色愈來愈暗，但他不想等到天亮，因為他在乎每一隻羊。他的狗 Max 衝進了樹林。幾分鐘後，Max 帶著那隻小羊回來了。小羊走路一拐一拐的，原來牠的腳被石頭弄傷了。林農夫把牠抱回家，讓牠那天晚上待在屋子裡。隔天早上，小羊好多了，而 Max 的早餐多了一根骨頭。

passages.title: 網路上賣舊球鞋
passages.text: Kai's feet grew so fast that his old basketball shoes did not fit anymore. They were still in good condition, so he decided to {1} them online. He took a {2} photos and wrote, "Size 26, used for six months, 800 dollars." Soon, a {3} of people sent him messages. One buyer asked him to mail the shoes first and said he would pay later. Kai's mom said, "Be careful. Some people want to cheat you. You might {4} your shoes and get no money." So Kai met a different buyer at the train station instead. The buyer paid him in cash, and Kai {5} the money for a new pair of shoes.

blanks.why: sell + 物 + online「在網路上賣」：他決定把舊鞋放到網路上賣。stay、care、hurt 都不能接 them online 表示賣東西。
a few photos「幾張照片」。a lot 後面要加 of；a chance photos、a park photos 都不通。
a lot of people「很多人」。a few 後面不加 of；a chance of、an example of people 都不通。
lose + 物「失去、損失」：你可能會損失鞋子，又拿不到錢。park、stay、care your shoes 都不通。
save money for …「為了…存錢」。stayed、hurt、cared 接 the money 都不通。

passages.zh: Kai 的腳長得好快，舊籃球鞋已經穿不下了。鞋子的狀況還很好，所以他決定放到網路上賣。他拍了幾張照片，寫上：「26 號，穿過六個月，800 元。」很快就有很多人傳訊息給他。有一個買家要他先把鞋子寄出去，說之後再付錢。Kai 的媽媽說：「小心，有些人想騙你。你可能會損失鞋子，又拿不到錢。」所以 Kai 改成和另一位買家約在火車站見面。對方用現金付款，Kai 把這筆錢存起來，要買一雙新鞋。

passages.title: 會照顧植物的機器人
passages.text: Rosa built a small robot for the science fair. Its job was to take {1} of plants. Every morning, it checked the soil and gave the plants water. When the sun was too strong, it moved them into the shade. "My mom {2} interest in plants after a week," Rosa told the judges. "But a robot never gets tired." The judges liked her idea. But during the show, the robot made a mistake. It gave one plant too much water, and the water went everywhere. A {3} judges laughed. Rosa was embarrassed, but she did not give up. "Every mistake is a {4} to learn," she said. She fixed the program that night, and the next day, the robot worked perfectly. Rosa won the "Best Idea" prize. Now the robot {5} in her living room and waters the plants every day.

blanks.why: take care of「照顧」：機器人的工作是照顧植物。take chance of、take example of、take lot of 都不對。
lose interest in …「對…失去興趣」：媽媽一週後就對植物沒興趣了。sells、parks、stays interest 都不通。
a few judges「幾位評審」。a lot 後面要加 of；a chance judges、a park judges 都不通。
a chance to learn「學習的機會」。example 前要用 an；a park、a care to learn 都不通。
stay in + 地方「待在…」：現在機器人待在她家客廳。sells、hurts、loses in her living room 都不通。

passages.zh: Rosa 為科展做了一個小機器人，它的工作是照顧植物。每天早上，它會檢查土壤、幫植物澆水；太陽太大時，它會把植物搬到陰涼處。「我媽媽照顧植物一個星期就沒興趣了，」Rosa 對評審說，「但機器人永遠不會累。」評審很喜歡她的點子。但展示的時候，機器人出錯了，它給一盆植物澆了太多水，水噴得到處都是。有幾位評審笑了出來。Rosa 很尷尬，但她沒有放棄。「每個錯誤都是學習的機會。」她說。那天晚上她修好了程式，隔天機器人運作得完美無缺。Rosa 得到了「最佳創意獎」。現在這個機器人待在她家客廳，每天幫植物澆水。

passages.title: 海綿寶寶請假一天
passages.text: SpongeBob loves his job at the Krusty Krab. He has never {1} home from work. But one morning, he woke up with a bad cold. "I cannot go to work today," he told Patrick. "Can you help Mr. Krabs?" Patrick said yes, but he did not know how to make Krabby Patties. He put a {2} of salt in them and forgot the bread. Customers were angry, and some of them left without paying. Mr. Krabs was worried. "We will {3} all our customers!" he shouted. Squidward did not {4} about the problem. He just read his magazine. The next day, SpongeBob came back, and everything was fine again. Mr. Krabs finally understood how important SpongeBob was, so he gave him a {5} extra dollars that week.

blanks.why: stay home from work「請假在家、不去上班」：他從來沒請假過。lost、sold、hurt home 都不通。
a lot of salt「很多鹽」。a few 後面不加 of，也不能接不可數的 salt；a chance of、an example of salt 都不通。
lose customers「失去客人」。park、stay、care 接 all our customers 都不通。
not care about …「不在乎…」：章魚哥一點都不在乎這個問題。stay about、park about、hurt about 都不通。
a few extra dollars「多幾塊錢」。a lot 後面要加 of；a care dollars、a park dollars 都不通。

passages.zh: 海綿寶寶很愛他在蟹堡王的工作，他從來沒有請假過。但有一天早上，他醒來時得了重感冒。「我今天不能去上班，」他對派大星說，「你可以去幫蟹老闆嗎？」派大星答應了，但他不會做美味蟹堡。他放了一大堆鹽，還忘了放麵包。客人很生氣，有些人沒付錢就走了。蟹老闆很擔心，大叫：「我們會失去所有的客人！」章魚哥一點都不在乎這個問題，只顧著看他的雜誌。隔天，海綿寶寶回來了，一切又恢復正常。蟹老闆終於明白海綿寶寶有多重要，所以那個星期多給了他幾塊錢。

passages.title: 爸爸的車在哪裡
passages.text: Last Sunday, we went shopping at a big mall. Dad found an empty space in the huge parking lot and {1} the car. "Don't worry. I never forget things," he said. We shopped for three hours and bought a {2} of things. When we came back, every floor of the parking lot looked the same. We could not find our car! We walked around for thirty minutes, and my feet started to {3}. Mom was angry. "You said you never forget things!" Then my sister had an idea. She took Dad's car key and pressed the button. Beep! Beep! A {4} rows away, our car's lights came on. Everyone laughed. Now Dad always takes a photo of the parking space. He does not want to {5} our car again.

blanks.why: park the car「停車」。cared、stayed、decided 都不能接 the car。
a lot of things「很多東西」。a few 後面不加 of；a chance of、an example of things 都不通。
start to hurt「開始痛」，hurt 當不及物動詞「疼痛」。sell、park、lose 後面需要受詞，放在這裡不通。
a few rows away「隔幾排」。a lot 後面要加 of；a chance rows、a care rows 都不通。
lose one's car「找不到車」：他不想再把車搞丟。sell、stay、care our car 都不通。

passages.zh: 上星期天，我們去一家大型購物中心逛街。爸爸在超大的停車場裡找到一個空位，把車停好。「別擔心，我從來不會忘東忘西。」他說。我們逛了三個小時，買了好多東西。回來的時候，停車場每一層看起來都一模一樣，我們找不到車子了！我們繞了三十分鐘，我的腳開始痛了。媽媽很生氣：「你不是說你從來不會忘東西嗎！」這時妹妹想到一個辦法，她拿爸爸的車鑰匙按下按鈕。嗶！嗶！隔了幾排的地方，我們的車燈亮了。大家都笑了。現在爸爸都會把停車位拍下來，他可不想再把車搞丟了。

passages.title: 第一條黑帶
passages.text: Min has learned taekwondo for five years. Last month, she had a {1} to take the black belt test. She was excited but also nervous. During practice, she kicked too hard and {2} her toe. Her coach said, "If your toe still hurts, you can wait for the next test." But Min did not want to {3} this chance. She rested and put ice on her toe every day. On the day of the test, a {4} of people came to watch. Min had to break three boards. She took a deep breath and kicked. Crack! All three boards broke. When the coach gave her the black belt, Min almost cried. "Hard work always {5} off," she said.

blanks.why: have a chance to + 原形動詞「有機會做…」。example 前要用 an；a park、a care to take 都不通。
hurt one's toe「傷到腳趾」。sold、stayed、parked 接 her toe 都不通。
lose a chance「錯過、失去機會」：她不想錯過這次機會。sell、park、stay this chance 都不通。
a lot of people「很多人」。a few 後面不加 of；a chance of、an example of people 都不通。
pay off「有回報、值得」：努力總會有回報。sells off、hurts off、parks off 都不是這個意思。

passages.zh: 阿敏學跆拳道已經五年了。上個月，她有機會參加黑帶考試。她既興奮又緊張。練習的時候，她踢得太用力，傷到了腳趾。教練說：「如果你的腳趾還會痛，可以等下一次考試。」但阿敏不想錯過這次機會。她每天休息、冰敷腳趾。考試當天，很多人來觀看。阿敏要踢斷三塊木板。她深吸一口氣，一腳踢出去。喀啦！三塊木板全斷了。教練把黑帶交給她時，阿敏差點哭出來。「努力總是會有回報的。」她說。

passages.title: 不吃人的小龍
passages.text: In a small village, people were afraid of the dragon on the mountain. They thought it ate people. One day, a girl named Nina went up the mountain to look for her goat. There, she saw the dragon. It was small, and it was crying. A big rock was on its tail. "Did the rock {1} you?" she asked. The dragon nodded. Nina pushed the rock away. The dragon was so thankful that it helped her find her goat. "Why do people think you eat them?" Nina asked. "I only eat a {2} apples a day," the dragon said. Nina took the dragon to the village. At first, people ran away. But Nina said, "Give it a {3}!" Soon, the villagers saw that the dragon was kind. Now it {4} near the village and keeps the wolves away. The children love it a {5}.

blanks.why: hurt + 人／動物「弄傷」：石頭弄傷你了嗎？sell、stay、park you 都不通。
a few apples「幾顆蘋果」。a lot 後面要加 of；a chance apples、a care apples 都不通。
give + 人 + a chance「給…一個機會」。example 前要用 an；give it a park、a care 都不通。
stay near …「待在…附近」：小龍現在住在村子附近。sells、hurts、loses near the village 都不通。
love … a lot「非常喜愛」。a few、a chance、a park 不能放在動詞後面表示程度。

passages.zh: 在一個小村莊裡，人們都很怕山上的龍，以為牠會吃人。有一天，一個叫 Nina 的女孩上山找她的山羊，在那裡看到了那條龍。牠很小，正在哭，一塊大石頭壓在牠的尾巴上。「石頭弄傷你了嗎？」她問。小龍點點頭。Nina 把石頭推開，小龍非常感激，幫她找到了山羊。「大家為什麼會覺得你吃人？」Nina 問。「我一天只吃幾顆蘋果。」小龍說。Nina 把小龍帶到村子裡，一開始大家都嚇跑了。但 Nina 說：「給牠一個機會吧！」很快地，村民發現小龍很善良。現在牠住在村子附近，幫大家趕走狼群。孩子們都非常喜歡牠。

passages.title: 班上的烏龜
passages.text: Our class has a pet turtle named Speedy. Every week, two students take {1} of him. Last Friday, it was my turn. I gave Speedy some food and cleaned his tank. But on Monday morning, the tank was empty! Did we {2} him? We had to find him before he {3} himself. Everyone looked under the desks and behind the bookshelves. After a {4} minutes, Amy found him in our teacher's shoe! Everyone laughed, even our teacher. "Speedy is not so slow after all," she said. Now we always {5} the lid on the tank.

blanks.why: take care of「照顧」：每週有兩個學生負責照顧牠。take chance of、take example of、take lot of 都不對。
lose + 動物「弄丟、走失」：我們把牠弄丟了嗎？park、stay、care him 都不通。
hurt oneself「受傷」：要在牠受傷之前找到牠。sold、stayed、parked himself 都不通。
after a few minutes「幾分鐘後」。a lot 後面要加 of；a chance minutes、a park minutes 都不通。
keep the lid on「讓蓋子一直蓋著」，keep 表示保持某種狀態。stay、hurt、care the lid 都不通。

passages.zh: 我們班養了一隻叫「飛快」的寵物烏龜，每週都有兩個學生負責照顧牠。上星期五輪到我，我餵了牠，也把水族箱清乾淨。但到了星期一早上，水族箱竟然是空的！我們把牠弄丟了嗎？我們得在牠受傷之前找到牠。大家找遍了桌子底下和書架後面。幾分鐘後，Amy 在老師的鞋子裡找到了牠！大家都笑了，連老師也笑了。「看來飛快一點也不慢嘛。」她說。現在我們都會把水族箱的蓋子蓋好。

passages.title: 媽祖遶境的人潮
passages.text: Every spring, my town holds a big festival for Mazu. Thousands of people come from all over Taiwan. The streets are so full that there is no place to {1}. This year, my mom and I went to see it. We walked for two hours with a {2} of other people. Along the road, people gave us free water and snacks. I held my mom's hand tightly because I did not want to {3} her in the crowd. Some old people walk for nine days. "Don't your legs {4}?" I asked an old woman. She smiled and said, "A little. But I do this to thank Mazu." I took a {5} pictures of her and the beautiful sedan chair. It was a day I will never forget.

blanks.why: no place to park「沒地方停車」。care、hurt、become 放在 no place to 後面都不通。
a lot of other people「很多其他的人」。a few 後面不加 of；a chance of、an example of people 都不通。
lose + 人 + in the crowd「在人群中走散」。sell、park、stay her 都不通。
Don't your legs hurt?「你的腳不會痛嗎？」hurt 當「疼痛」。sell、stay、park 和 your legs 搭配都不通。
a few pictures「幾張照片」。a lot 後面要加 of；a chance pictures、a care pictures 都不通。

passages.zh: 每年春天，我們鎮上都會舉辦盛大的媽祖慶典，成千上萬的人從台灣各地來參加。街上擠滿了人，根本沒地方停車。今年我和媽媽一起去看，跟著好多人走了兩個小時。沿路上，有人免費送水和點心給我們。我緊緊牽著媽媽的手，因為我不想在人群中和她走散。有些老人家會連走九天。「你的腳不會痛嗎？」我問一位老奶奶。她笑著說：「有一點。但我這樣做是為了感謝媽祖。」我幫她和漂亮的神轎拍了幾張照片。那是我永遠不會忘記的一天。

passages.title: 外送員舅舅
passages.text: My uncle is a food delivery worker. He rides his scooter all day and brings food to people's homes. Last week, he told me about his hardest day. "It was raining hard," he said. "I could not find a place to {1} my scooter, so I had to walk in the rain. The customer lived on the tenth floor, and there was no elevator. My legs {2} so much! When I got there, the customer was angry because the food was late. He did not {3} about the rain. But the next customer was an old lady. She gave me a hot drink and a {4} cookies. She told me to {5} inside until the rain stopped. Kind people like her make my job worth it." Now I always say thank you to delivery workers.

blanks.why: park one's scooter「停機車」。care、become、stay 都不能接 my scooter。
my legs hurt「我的腳很痛」，hurt 過去式不變。sold、parked、cared so much 都不通。
not care about …「不在乎…」：客人根本不管下雨。sell about、park about、lose about 都不通。
a few cookies「幾塊餅乾」。a lot 後面要加 of；a chance cookies、a park cookies 都不通。
tell + 人 + to stay inside「叫某人待在室內」。sell、lose、hurt inside 都不通。

passages.zh: 我舅舅是美食外送員，他每天騎著機車把食物送到別人家。上星期，他跟我說了他最辛苦的一天。「那天雨下得很大，」他說，「我找不到地方停機車，只好淋雨走路。客人住在十樓，又沒有電梯，我的腳痛死了！到了之後，客人因為餐點遲到而生氣，他根本不在乎下雨。但下一位客人是一位老太太，她給了我一杯熱飲和幾塊餅乾，還叫我待在屋裡等雨停。就是因為有像她這樣親切的人，我的工作才值得。」現在我都會對外送員說謝謝。

passages.title: 神燈的三個願望
passages.text: Tim found an old lamp in his grandpa's house. When he cleaned it, a genie came out! "I can give you three wishes," the genie said. "But be careful. You will only have one {1} for each wish." First, Tim wished for a {2} of money. Money fell from the sky. Then he wished to {3} young forever. But his third wish surprised the genie. Tim's dog, Bobo, was old and sick. "Please make Bobo healthy again," he said. "Money and being young are nice, but I do not want to {4} my best friend." Bobo jumped up and ran around the room. The genie smiled. "Most people only think about themselves. But you {5} about your friend. That was your best wish."

blanks.why: one chance for each wish「每個願望只有一次機會」。example 前要用 an；one park、one care 都不通。
a lot of money「很多錢」。a few 後面不加 of，也不能接不可數的 money；a chance of、a park of money 都不通。
stay young「保持年輕」，stay 後面可接形容詞表示「保持某種狀態」。sell、lose、care young 都不通。
lose + 人「失去某人」：我不想失去最好的朋友。sell、park、stay my best friend 都不通。
care about …「關心、在乎」，過去式 cared。sold、stayed、parked about 都不通。

passages.zh: Tim 在爺爺家發現了一盞舊燈。他擦燈的時候，一個精靈跑了出來！「我可以給你三個願望，」精靈說，「但要小心，每個願望只有一次機會。」首先，Tim 許願要很多錢，錢就從天上掉下來了。接著，他許願要永遠保持年輕。但他的第三個願望讓精靈很驚訝。Tim 的狗 Bobo 又老又病。「請讓 Bobo 恢復健康，」他說，「錢和年輕都很好，但我不想失去我最好的朋友。」Bobo 跳了起來，在房間裡跑來跑去。精靈笑了：「大部分的人只想到自己，但你關心你的朋友。這是你許過最好的願望。」
